# WG7 · Doanh số của tôi · Tiền thủ thuật (bác sĩ)

Group **WG · Tài chính PB02** · state · Next.js: **planned (U6)** (`/finance`) · account `doctor-mai`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/finance/finance.js#work`
- Finance PB02 is `prototype/finance/finance.js` (`PemaFinance.html()` + `mount(root)`), mounted inside the clinic shell; data comes from the Python API `finance_server.py` on 127.0.0.1:4174 with the headers `X-Pema-Role` and `X-Pema-Doctor`.
- `work()` for the doctor: own rows only, no entry form, no approve, void, close or export commands except the export button.
- Inventory note: Doctor projection of the work table: no entry form, no approve or void buttons, no period buttons. The rates and receipts tabs are hidden for a doctor (their placeholder panels are unreachable).
- Page key `finance` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `doctor-mai`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"finance\"]"} → {"wait":".finance-workspace .metric, .finance-workspace .hero"} → {"click":"[data-finance-tab=\"work\"]"} → {"wait":"#export"}; it must show `#export`.

## Layout (top to bottom, region → src/ui component)
Every field, action, status, filter and text of the old screen is listed; rows and cards that repeat show the first one with demo values and their count. `old="…"` is the old CSS class, `// key=value` the old `data-*` hook that carries the behaviour.
```tsx
<AppShell role="doctor-mai">  // sidebar and top bar are the same on every page (WA1-WA3); active menu item "Doanh số của tôi", page key "finance"
  <Row gap="20px" justify="space-between">
    <Text small>"ĐIỀU HÀNH • PEMA CLINIC"</Text>
    <Heading level={1}>"Tài chính & tiền thủ thuật"</Heading>
    <Row old="tools" gap="12px" wrap>
      <Field label="Kỳ báo cáo" type="month" default="2026-09" id="month" />
      <Button variant="secondary">"Làm mới"</Button>
    </Row>
  </Row>
  <nav aria-label="Phân hệ tài chính" old="finance-tabs">
    <Tabs items={["Tổng quan","Tiền thủ thuật"]} selected="Tiền thủ thuật" />  // financeTab
  </nav>
  <Card old="panel">
    <Row old="row" gap="12px" justify="space-between" wrap>
      <Heading level={2}>"Bảng tiền thủ thuật • 2026-09"</Heading>
      <Badge tone="neutral" old="badge">"Đang đối soát"</Badge>
      <Button variant="secondary">"Xuất CSV cho Excel"</Button>
    </Row>
    <TableShell columns={["Ngày / Hồ sơ","Thủ thuật / Bác sĩ","Doanh số phân bổ","Cơ sở × tỷ lệ","Tiền thủ thuật","Trạng thái"]} rows={3}>
      <Row sample="first of 3; demo values, the other rows have the same cells">
        <Cell column="Ngày / Hồ sơ">
          <Text>"2026-09-02" <Small>"P002"</Small></Text>
        </Cell>
        <Cell column="Thủ thuật / Bác sĩ">
          <Text>"Tư vấn da liễu" <Small>"BS. Mai"</Small></Text>
        </Cell>
        <Cell column="Doanh số phân bổ">
          <Text>"500.000 ₫"</Text>
        </Cell>
        <Cell column="Cơ sở × tỷ lệ">
          <Text>"500.000 ₫ × 15%" <Small>"Giá sau giảm"</Small></Text>
        </Cell>
        <Cell column="Tiền thủ thuật">
          <Text strong>"75.000 ₫"</Text>
        </Cell>
        <Cell column="Trạng thái">
          <Badge tone="neutral" old="badge">"Đã duyệt"</Badge>
        </Cell>
      </Row>
      <RowVariants>statuses "Đã duyệt" (badge) ×3</RowVariants>
    </TableShell>
  </Card>
</AppShell>
```
Kit components used: Button×2, Badge×2, Field×1, Tabs×1, Card×1, TableShell×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

## Business rules
- Revenue ("Doanh số thực hiện") follows the completion date of the procedure; cash ("Thực thu") follows the receipt date; they are tracked separately.
- "Tiền thủ thuật đã duyệt": "Không phải lợi nhuận phòng khám".

## Differences from the app design
- (none recorded)

## Gotchas
- The tab content refreshes every 10 s (`setInterval`) unless an input has focus or the entry form is open; a pending form is never overwritten (`dirty` flag).
- Without the API the page shows "Chưa kết nối dữ liệu tài chính: <error>. Chạy python prototype/finance_server.py rồi thử lại." in `#error` (see WG9).
